2609.31261.title: MoSAR: Mixture of Semantic Attention Regimes for Learning Adaptive and Approximable Attention Geometries
2609.31261.paper_summary: The quadratic complexity of dense self-attention remains a central bottleneck for long-context language modeling. Many efficient alternatives address this cost by deciding in advance where attention should be sparse or local. We argue that attention approximation should instead be approached as a geometric problem, with the relevant interaction geometry learned from data: natural-language dependencies are input-dependent and difficult to prescribe in advance, so the model should learn where positional relevance can decay and where broader interactions must be preserved. We introduce Mixture of Semantic Attention Regimes (MoSAR), which learns such an adaptive, controlled-decay geometry over query--key interactions. Input-conditioned query and key routers, applied after positional encoding, select mixtures over short, medium, and global regimes, inducing a continuous distance-dependent attention field rather than a fixed sparsity pattern. This geometry is learned during training and can subsequently be discretized through top-1 routing. In controlled pre-training experiments with matched 500M-parameter models, MoSAR learns a substantially lower-reach attention geometry without degrading language-modeling quality, improving perplexity over dense RoPE at the training context length. Under length extrapolation, MoSAR achieves the best perplexity among all evaluated variants, including strong baselines such as ALiBi. Moreover, the learned geometry remains stable under deterministic top-1 discretization, suggesting that it is not only adaptive, but also amenable to low-cost approximation at inference time.
2609.31261.paper_summary_zh: 密集自注意力的二次複雜性仍然是長上下文語言建模的主要瓶頸。許多高效的替代方案通過提前決定注意力應該在哪裡稀疏或局部來解決這一成本。我們認為，注意力近似應該被視為一個幾何問題，相關的互動幾何應從數據中學習：自然語言依賴是依賴於輸入的，並且難以提前規定，因此模型應該學習位置相關性可以衰減的地方，以及必須保留更廣泛互動的地方。我們介紹了語義注意力模式混合（MoSAR），它在查詢-鍵互動中學習這樣一個自適應的、受控衰減幾何。在位置編碼之後應用的輸入條件查詢和鍵路由器，選擇短期、中期和全局模式的混合，從而產生一個連續的距離依賴注意力場，而不是固定的稀疏模式。這種幾何在訓練過程中學習，並可以通過 top-1 路由隨後進行離散化。在與匹配的 500M 參數模型的受控預訓練實驗中，MoSAR 學習到了一種顯著較低範圍的注意力幾何，而不降低語言建模質量，在訓練上下文長度上改善了密集 RoPE 的困惑度。在長度外推下，MoSAR 在所有評估變體中達到了最佳困惑度，包括強基準如 ALiBi。此外，學到的幾何在確定性 top-1 離散化下保持穩定，這表明它不僅是自適應的，還適合於推理時的低成本近似。
